2608.06948.title: LMM Modality Transfer: A Pre-requisite for Autonomous GIS Agents
2608.06948.paper_summary: AI models are becoming increasingly adept at understanding and processing spatial information, thereby facilitating agentic problem-solving in spatial tasks and workflows. However, most of the research on their spatial capabilities (e.g., spatial reasoning) has focused on the textual modality as input and output. This contrasts with the human approach to GIS workflows, where text and visual modalities are often used together, interchangeably, and in a complementary manner. Thus, to truly achieve an automated GIS analysis pipeline or carry out human-designed GIS workflows, AI models --- Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) in particular --- need to be able to seamlessly transition between image- and text-based modalities that are traditionally used in such workflows. We present a modality transfer task that (1) asks an LMM to first describe an input image of colored squares in a regular grid, and (2) asks a new LMM instance to re-generate an image of the original spatial scene using the textual description output by the former model. This task quantifies the ability of LMMs to transfer spatial information between image and text modalities. Ultimately, by examining the modality transfer capability of LMMs through the lens of spatial information theory, this work highlights a critical bottleneck: achieving strong and robust geospatial understanding in LMMs requires rigorous, multi-modal alignment. Our results indicate that recent LMMs (here from OpenAI) still struggle with modality transfer, when tasked with re-generating an image of a simple spatial grid of color squares.
2608.06948.paper_summary_zh: AI 模型在理解和處理空間資訊方面變得越來越熟練，從而促進了在空間任務和工作流程中的自主問題解決。<lb/>然而，大多數關於它們空間能力（例如，空間推理）的研究都集中在文本模態作為輸入和輸出。<lb/>這與人類對地理資訊系統（GIS）工作流程的處理方式形成對比，在這種方式中，文本和視覺模態通常是一起使用的，並且是可以互換和互補的。<lb/>因此，為了真正實現自動化的 GIS 分析管道或執行人類設計的 GIS 工作流程，AI 模型——特別是大型多模態模型（LMMs）——需要能夠在這些工作流程中傳統使用的基於圖像和基於文本的模態之間無縫過渡。<lb/>我們提出了一個模態轉換任務，該任務 (1) 要求 LMM 首先描述一個有色方塊的輸入圖像，這些方塊排列在一個規則的網格中，並且 (2) 要求一個新的 LMM 實例使用前一模型輸出的文本描述重新生成原始空間場景的圖像。<lb/>這個任務量化了 LMM 在圖像和文本模態之間轉移空間資訊的能力。<lb/>最終，通過空間資訊理論的視角來檢視 LMM 的模態轉換能力，本研究突顯了一個關鍵瓶頸：在 LMM 中實現強大而穩健的地理空間理解需要嚴謹的多模態對齊。<lb/>我們的結果表明，最近的 LMM（這裡來自 OpenAI）在模態轉換方面仍然存在困難，當被要求重新生成一個簡單的顏色方塊空間網格的圖像時。
